description: Every G2 Marketplace surface, plus a credit-aware local mirror, full-text review search, and buyer-intent triage no other G2 tool offers.

novel_features.name: Cross-product weekly diff
novel_features.description: Diff star ratings, new review counts, and badge changes across a list of products since a given window.

novel_features.name: Credit-burn forecast
novel_features.description: Project month-end credit spend from trailing 14-day usage and refuse sync runs that would exceed remaining credits.

novel_features.name: Multi-product review FTS
novel_features.description: Full-text search across locally synced reviews, scoped by product list and structured filters (rating, segment).

novel_features.name: Alternatives-signal switching threats
novel_features.description: Rank companies showing Alternatives-signal buyer intent against your product, weighted by visit count and employee size.

novel_features.name: Category rising-challenger detector
novel_features.description: Per category, surface products in the top growth quartile by 30-day review velocity that aren't yet top quartile by absolute review count.

novel_features.name: Buyer-intent triage CSV
novel_features.description: Filter buyer-intent rows by recency and minimum score and flatten nested firmographics into a sales-ready CSV.

novel_features.name: Reviews x competitors top-cons
novel_features.description: For each product in a list, return the lowest-rated reviews and their cons verbatims as JSON for downstream summarization.

novel_features.name: Syndication-eligible review filter
novel_features.description: Filter synced reviews for the syndication-eligible flag, scoped by product and a recency window.

novel_features.name: Market-signal weekly diff
novel_features.description: Diff locally snapshotted market_signals for a category over a window; emit intent-score and visits-count deltas.
